The article reports all 54 randomized patients were followed, with 27 patients in group A and 27 in group B. It does not explicitly state a 1-year survival rate, but it reports postoperative 1-year mortality: A group 25.93% (7/27) and B group 77.78% (21/27). Because all patients were followed, the number alive at 1 year can be calculated as total minus deaths. Thus, A group survivors = 27 - 7 = 20, and B group survivors = 27 - 21 = 6.

It does not report a 1-year survival rate or the number of patients alive 1 year after treatment. Although evaluable sample sizes were 43 in the intervention group and 42 in the control group, these are not tied to a matched 1-year survival outcome.
